trigger trg_permissions_generation on permissions enabled=A: CREATE TRIGGER trg_permissions_generation AFTER INSERT OR DELETE OR UPDATE OR TRUNCATE ON permissions FOR EACH STATEMENT EXECUTE FUNCTION keyorix_bump_role_permissions_generation()

trigger trg_secret_nodes_cache_epoch on secret_nodes enabled=A: CREATE TRIGGER trg_secret_nodes_cache_epoch BEFORE UPDATE ON secret_nodes FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION keyorix_secret_nodes_bump_cache_epoch()
trigger trg_secret_nodes_suspend_marker on secret_nodes enabled=A: CREATE TRIGGER trg_secret_nodes_suspend_marker BEFORE UPDATE OF status ON secret_nodes FOR EACH ROW WHEN (((new.status IS DISTINCT FROM 'suspended'::text) AND new.suspend_clear_synced_copies)) EXECUTE FUNCTION keyorix_clear_suspend_marker()
trigger trg_system_metadata_retention_anchor_v2 on system_metadata enabled=A: CREATE TRIGGER trg_system_metadata_retention_anchor_v2 BEFORE UPDATE ON system_metadata FOR EACH ROW WHEN ((old.key = 'audit_retention_anchor'::text)) EXECUTE FUNCTION keyorix_keep_retention_anchor_v2()
